_about: Facts for the static airline pages (tools/build_airline_pages.py). Written by lane 5 (AN23) on 2026-11-14. The commitments themselves stay in dot-commitments.json (lane 1).

dot_reread.result: All 144 Yes/No cells (9 airlines, 8 commitments, cancellation and delay tables) match dot-commitments.json. Spirit has no column. No change made to dot-commitments.json.

plan_links.method: One GET per link, status only (script, then a normal browser for the ones the script could not open). The plan pages were not read. ok = opens; blocked = the script is refused or cannot connect but the page opens in a normal browser; dead = server error or not found. The page builder links ok and blocked links, and not dead ones.

hawaiian.note: The listed address moves (301, 308) to the airline's current customer commitment page.

united.note: The script could not connect (timeout, HTTP/2 error). The page opens in a normal browser.

spirit.note: HTTP 502 Bad Gateway on three tries and in a browser.
